name: PASCAL VOC Challenge
description: PASCAL VOC Challenge is an early and highly influential vision benchmark for object detection, semantic segmentation, action classification, and related recognition tasks.
evaluation_method: Mean Average Precision (mAP) for detection/classification and intersection-over-union-based metrics for segmentation.
typical_sota_score: Near-saturated on the original benchmark by modern methods.
notes: Historically important and still widely cited, but it is largely considered solved compared with newer large-scale vision benchmarks.
